title: 1440. Sorting Strings by Length Stably
description:

Submissions

. 
Sorting Strings by Length Stably
20
Easy
Problem Statement:
Given an array of strings, write a program to sort the strings in increasing order of their lengths. If two strings have the same length, maintain their original relative order (stable sorting). 
Input Description:
You are given an array of strings, and you need to sort them based on their lengths. If multiple strings have the same length, their relative order should not change from the input order.
The first line contains an integer N — the number of strings.
The next N lines each contain a string. 
Output Description:
Print the sorted array of strings, each on a new line. 
Sample Input:
5
apple
banana
kiwi
grape
orange 
Sample Output:
kiwi
grape
apple
banana
orange
